edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by the onlyValidSender modifier for registry authorization.
onlyValidSender gates execution of giftNifty.
onlyValidSender gates execution of massMintNFTs.
onlyValidSender gates execution of setNiftyName.
onlyValidSender gates execution of setNiftyIPFSHash.
onlyValidSender gates execution of setDateTimeContract.
msg.sender is forwarded as argument to the external isValidNiftySender registry call.
niftyRegistryContract address is used as the target of the registry external call.
giftNifty requires isGiftNiftyPermitted to return true.
_numNiftyMinted counter current value is read while checking mint permission.
_numNiftyPermitted limit is read while checking mint permission.
giftNifty performs the external encodeTokenId call.
masterBuilderContract address is used as the target of encodeTokenId.
giftNifty mints the encoded token via _mint.
_numNiftyMinted counter is incremented and read inside giftNifty.
collector_address parameter flows into _mint inside giftNifty.
nifty_type parameter flows into permission checks and token encoding.
massMintNFTs repeatedly invokes giftNifty in a loop.
Loop counter i controls massMintNFTs iteration count.
num_to_mint parameter bounds the massMintNFTs loop.
nifty_type parameter is forwarded to giftNifty by massMintNFTs.
block.timestamp is passed into DateTimeAPI.getHour, making logic timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is passed into DateTimeAPI.getDay, making logic timestamp dependent.
tokenIPFSHash executes DateTimeAPI.getHour(block.timestamp) for nifty type 1.
tokenIPFSHash executes DateTimeAPI.getDay(block.timestamp) for nifty type 3.
tokenIPFSHash performs the external getNiftyTypeId call.
masterBuilderContract address is used as the target of getNiftyTypeId.
dateTimeContract address is used to instantiate DateTimeAPI in tokenIPFSHash.
tokenId parameter is used for existence check and nifty type lookup.
Resolved nifty type local variable selects which artifact hash is returned.
Local hour derived from block.timestamp selects day or night artifact.
Local index derived from day modulo returns artifact_3 entry.
_dateTimeContract parameter is written into dateTimeContract state variable.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer after authorization.
safeTransferFrom reaches the external receiver callback via _checkOnERC721Received.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an untrusted callback into the recipient contract.
Recipient callback can re-enter transfer logic reachable from _transfer.
_mint increments _balances[to] with unchecked-style arithmetic on user balances.
_burn decrements _balances[owner] and can underflow without proper checks.
_transfer performs _balances[from] -= 1 and _balances[to] += 1.
burn delegates to _burn after authorization.
msg.sender is checked against owner/approved before burning.
msg.sender is checked by _isApprovedOrOwner before transferFrom.
msg.sender is checked by _isApprovedOrOwner before safeTransferFrom.
sendValue performs an external low level call to the recipient before returning.
recipient parameter is the target of the low level value call.
amount parameter is the value forwarded by sendValue.
increment performs unchecked counter._value += 1.
decrement performs unchecked counter._value = value - 1 after a require.
isContract uses inline assembly extcodesize to inspect an address.
target/account address parameter is inspected by the extcodesize helper.
data bytes parameter flows through the Address call helpers.
value parameter is forwarded by functionCallWithValue helpers.
owner parameter is used in balance and approval view logic.
operator parameter participates in approval authorization checks.
to parameter is the destination of internal transfers.
from parameter is the source of internal transfers.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient address parameter is only meaningful as the mint target inside giftNifty.
Nifty type parameter is consumed by permission check and token encoding in giftNifty.
Loop bound parameter only exists to drive the massMintNFTs loop.
Loop counter local variable is scoped to massMintNFTs iteration.
Token id parameter is used for existence check in tokenIPFSHash.
Local nifty type resolved inside tokenIPFSHash for artifact selection.
Local artifact index computed inside tokenIPFSHash.
Local hour variable is the direct result of the unsafe getHour timestamp call.
New datetime address parameter is written to state only inside setDateTimeContract.
Owner parameter participates only in view-based balance and approval queries.
Operator parameter is only used for authorization checks in transfer paths.
Destination parameter is only consumed by the internal transfer routine.
Source parameter is only consumed by the internal transfer routine.
Recipient payable parameter is only the target of the low level value call in sendValue.
Amount parameter is only the wei value forwarded by sendValue.
Target address parameter is only inspected by the extcodesize helper.
Data bytes parameter only flows through the Address low level call helpers.
Value parameter only flows through the Address value-forwarding call helpers.
